messages.subject: Project Falcon - cap and advance payment
messages.plaintextBody:
Rohan,

To confirm before we respond to Denham Lewis: we'll hold 30-day payment terms but offer to reduce the signature advance from 15% to 10% (i.e. £6.24m instead of £9.36m) as the trade. On liability we're landing at 135% of trailing Charges with a £17.5m supply super-cap. Are you comfortable on the cash impact of the lower advance?

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
